Privacy Policy

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect any personal information you provide when using this website. By accessing or using our website, you agree to the terms outlined below.

1. Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

  • Non-personal data such as browser type, IP address, device information, and referral source (used for analytics and traffic monitoring).
  • Voluntary data you provide when contacting us via email or forms (e.g., your name, email address, or message content).

We do not collect or store sensitive financial data, passwords, or payment information on this website.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your data solely for the following purposes:

  • To respond to contact or feedback requests
  • To improve website performance and usability through analytics
  • To monitor and prevent fraudulent or unauthorized activity
  • To comply with legal obligations or enforce site terms

We do not use your data for profiling or sell your personal information to third parties.

3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies

This website may use cookies to:

  • Remember your preferences
  • Understand visitor behavior
  • Track performance through tools such as Google Analytics

You may disable cookies via your browser settings. Disabling cookies may impact certain website features.

4. Third-Party Links

Our website includes outbound links to third-party online casinos and other affiliate partners. Once you leave our site, we are not responsible for the privacy practices or content on those external sites. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies individually.

5. Data Storage & Security

We take reasonable technical and organizational precautions to prevent the loss, misuse, or alteration of your personal data. Any data you voluntarily provide is stored securely and only accessible to authorized personnel.

6. Affiliate Disclosure

Some of the links on our site are affiliate links. This means we may receive a commission if you click through and sign up with a third-party site. This has no effect on our editorial independence or how we score or review casinos.

7. Your Rights

Under applicable laws, you may have the right to:

  • Request access to any personal data we hold about you
  • Request corrections or deletion of your data
  • Withdraw consent for data usage (where applicable)
  • File a complaint with a data protection authority

To exercise any of these rights, contact us at info@casinomyinsider.com.

8. Policy Updates

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.
